dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source receipt system); uses ORCMCPSUB/ORCSDAY call conventions typical of GnuCOBOL-based ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu) system — point-score master (tensu master) validity-date change management screen Z07
purpose.summary: This program implements screen Z07 of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system, handling the expiry/change of validity dates on the point-score (tensu) master table. It initialises the screen, retrieves tensu master records filtered by validity date via a database call, and manages screen navigation and SPA (scratchpad area) state for the operator.

notable_features: 31 COPY statements (heavy use of copybooks for screen areas, DB areas, sub-parameter areas)
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA/SCRAREA passed via USING
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen dispatch
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB layer
OCCURS 200 for tensu list in SPA area
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in EUC-JP Japanese but the file was decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. Content is clearly readable as COBOL. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (~23% of total 70845 bytes); the procedure division logic continues beyond the shown portion. No COMP-3 usage despite being a numeric-heavy medical billing program — likely uses display numerics throughout.
